theme: Light theme preferred (Trust, transparency, government-level clarity but modern SaaS execution)

headings.usage: Used for page titles, section headers, hero text, and important numbers.

body.usage: Used for data tables, forms, small labels, descriptions, and all dashboard metrics.

rules: Overlines / Labels MUST be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Never use pure black or pure gray. Grays must be tinted slightly with blue (Slate/Zinc).
Only use Primary color (Emerald) for CTAs, active states, and AI accents.
Do NOT use heavy gradients. Limit to extremely subtle, high-transparency backgrounds if needed.

surfaces.name: Glassmorphism (Header/Nav)
surfaces.usage: Sticky navigation, mobile bottom tab bar.

surfaces.name: Dashboard Cards
surfaces.usage: Admin widgets, resident report cards, finance tables.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0. Rounded corners: rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-2xl for hero images, rounded-full for pills/buttons.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Primary uses Emerald background. Subtle scale-down on click (active:scale-95).
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but customized to rounded-lg, border-slate-200, focus:ring-emerald-500.
components.tables: Clean, border-b only for rows (no vertical borders). Right-aligned numbers for finance.
components.badges: Soft background + dark text. rounded-full text-xs font-medium px-2.5 py-0.5.
components.ai_search: Prominent, modern shadow, subtle glowing border on focus, with an AI sparkle icon.

grids_layouts.mobile_resident: Mobile-first approach. Max-w-md mx-auto for resident views, bottom navigation bar (fixed bottom-0 z-50). Ample vertical spacing.
grids_layouts.desktop_admin: Bento Grid strategy (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Cards span 1 or 2 columns based on metric importance.
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 for cards. gap-6 for lists. Section spacing py-16 or py-24 for landing page.

motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations via framer-motion (initial opacity 0, y 20).
rules: Do not use `transition: all` broadly, specify properties.
Animations should be snappy (<= 300ms) and purposeful.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet WCAG AA. Emerald text on white must be at least #059669.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

media.icons: lucide-react for all general icons. Consistent stroke width (1.5 or 2).
media.charts: recharts (LineChart for 6-month trend, BarChart for report analytics, PieChart for AI breakdown). Minimal grid lines, no legend clutter.

hero_background.description: Indonesian neighborhood with buildings (for landing page context).

community_activity.description: People gathering, for community announcements and activities.

instructions_to_main_agent: Language: Entire UI MUST be in Bahasa Indonesia.
Create a responsive multi-layout app: Marketing landing page, mobile-first Resident portal (with bottom nav), and desktop-first Admin Command Center.
Implement clear routing using react-router-dom for the specified routes.
Do NOT use pure black backgrounds or overly heavy gradients. Use the specified Slate/Emerald palette.
Use Shadcn UI customized with our specific border-radii and colors.
Ensure the Resident dashboard utilizes a fixed bottom navigation bar on mobile.
Implement the 'Community Pulse' score (87/100) using Recharts or a custom circular progress.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and links.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers and navs. NEVER use pure transparency without blur/background for content overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide icons instead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute.
